answer: Trust propagates via bounded random walks across an attestation graph: an honest seed’s influence decays through sparse cuts, while an adversarial Sybil cluster is a hollow region with low conductance, φ(S)=cut(S, S̄)/vol(S). Conductance bounds escape probability and, via min-cut transitivity, caps the cluster’s aggregate voting weight; even a glacier-slow bridge cannot move its influence beyond the honest horizon without independent attestations.
